correctness.rationale: For N<=16, every positive-integer partition and distinct unordered pair of taxon entries is enumerated; exact covariance identity yields all rational variance differences for m=2..N-1. Every original/coarsened richness distribution is independently reconstructed by integer generating-function coefficient multiplication, and all moments agree. The unique N=16 witness has three strict adjacent sign reversals at 4->5, 7->8, and 14->15; all N<=15 types have fewer. The included checker regenerates the entire complete census. No assertion for larger N.

value.rationale: Taxonomic coarsening is an unavoidable comparison problem for biodiversity surveys. The variance of rarefied richness under exactly one category merger has alternating directions at three different adjacent sampling depths, despite its expected richness never increasing; the threshold 16 and unique minimum construction form a natural complete finite classification of this nonmonotonicity. This is not an arbitrary parameter slice or a reprint of the classical moment formula; it quantifies a previously unclassified instability in sampling uncertainty. No extrapolation or empirical effect size is asserted.
